summary: Non-custodial Ethereum swaps and managed liquidity. You sign every tx; FluxIQ holds no funds.

toolsPreview.name: quote_swap
toolsPreview.description: Read-only ERC20 swap quote: expected out, guaranteed minOut, fee, and a high-level route summary. No broadcast.

toolsPreview.name: build_swap
toolsPreview.description: Build a NON-CUSTODIAL ERC20 swap plan (approve → Permit2 sign → router.swap) for the caller to sign + broadcast. No broadcast.

toolsPreview.name: quote_lp_deposit
toolsPreview.description: Read-only any-token LP deposit preview: estimated shares, guaranteed minShares, fee, and refund bps. No broadcast.

toolsPreview.name: build_lp_deposit
toolsPreview.description: Build a NON-CUSTODIAL any-token LP deposit plan (approve → Permit2 sign → router.depositAnyToken) for the caller to sign + broadcast. No broadcast.

toolsPreview.name: quote_lp_withdraw
toolsPreview.description: Read-only any-token LP withdraw preview: estimated and guaranteed token-out for burning vault shares. No broadcast.

toolsPreview.name: build_lp_withdraw
toolsPreview.description: Build a NON-CUSTODIAL any-token LP withdraw plan (approve shares → Permit2 sign → router.withdrawAnyToken) for the caller to sign + broadcast. No broadcast.

toolsPreview.name: list_vaults
toolsPreview.description: List the public any-token LP vaults (addresses + token pair). Public market data only — no user-private reads.

toolsPreview.name: list_tokens
toolsPreview.description: List the public swap token allow-list (address/symbol/name/decimals). Public market data only — no user-private reads.
